weeks.headline: Messaging, remade
weeks.dek: Photos you can mark up, voice notes that look like a radio intercept, and stickers that finally feel like messages. On every platform at once.

items.title: Edit a photo before you send it
items.body: Crop, draw, add text and stickers, write a caption. Change your mind and re-open the edit before it goes.

items.title: Full-screen photos that zoom
items.body: Tap any photo in a chat. Pinch, double-tap, scroll the wheel, pan around.

items.title: Voice notes, as a thermal readout
items.body: Record right inside the text field. The waveform follows your real voice, and sent notes play back like a radio pickup.

items.title: Stickers and GIFs, one tap away
items.body: They send as their own messages, and the picker stays open so you can send a few in a row.

items.title: A camera-first + button
items.body: The + opens our own half sheet: camera up top, then photos, files, location.

items.title: Find anyone on Jokuh
items.body: New Call and Find people now search everyone, not just the people you already know.

weeks.headline: Walkie-talkie, Fuel, and the week ahead
weeks.dek: Our busiest week yet: voice messages you hold to talk, an Arcade that runs on its own token, and a Spine that knows what's on near you.

items.title: Walkie-talkie voice messages
items.body: Tap to record hands-free, or hold to talk and let go to send. With a little splat when it lands.

items.title: Shared Spine, inside the chat
items.body: Open a conversation and see the year you two have had: calls, photos, plans, all in one lane.

items.title: Events you're going to, and ones nearby
items.body: Your RSVPs show up as rich Going rows, with suggestions for what's on around you. Hours with an event glow Jokuh orange.

items.title: The Arcade runs on Fuel
items.body: Tickets, payouts and prizes all run on Fuel, the Arcade's own token. Everyday games stay free.

items.title: Tip with Batcoin, hold your own Zcash
items.body: Tip people across the app, and keep Zcash in a wallet only you hold the keys to.

items.title: Chats open instantly, even offline
items.body: Your history paints from the device the moment you open a chat, signal or not.

weeks.headline: Gooey, for everyone
weeks.dek: One look across every screen, calls that connect the first time, and a Mac palette that finds anything.

items.title: Gooey is the new look
items.body: Glassy chrome, Satoshi type, and Gooey Light and Dark themes, on by default for everyone.

items.title: Real squircles, everywhere
items.body: Every container uses the same fully smoothed corner as our Figma files. You feel it more than you see it.

items.title: Calls that just connect
items.body: Audio that doesn't drop out, 1080p video, and one control dock instead of three.

items.title: Connect your apps in one tap
items.body: Link the apps you use, and OO can work with them inside your DMs and huddles.

items.title: A palette that finds anything
items.body: Memories, chats, people, sites you've visited, a world clock and unit conversions, a keystroke away.

items.title: Your space
items.body: Your own blurbs orbit your profile, and the pod turns into a composer while it's open.

weeks.headline: A calmer Jokuh
weeks.dek: We took things away this week. The core app gets quieter, and the extras wait until you ask for them.

items.title: Extra tools, off until you want them
items.body: The experimental stuff now lives behind one switch in Settings. Out of the box you get calls, texts, Spine and your profile.

items.title: Calls and DMs show the essentials
items.body: Beta buttons and message actions move behind the same switch, so the everyday screens stay clean.

items.title: Less work in the background
items.body: The web app skips the heavy background work until you need it.

weeks.headline: Under the hood
weeks.dek: A quiet week on the surface. Underneath, we tightened the walls around your account.

items.title: Stronger account boundaries
items.body: A full pass over sign-in, database access rules and our service gateway.

items.title: Recovers when things go wrong
items.body: New crash and timeout recovery, so a bad network moment doesn't take the app down with it.

items.title: A cleaner wallet
items.body: A new wallet header and simpler token rows.

weeks.headline: Blurbs on your profile
weeks.dek: Your blurbs get a home on your ID, and OO learns to look after the people and pets in your life.

items.title: A Blurbs pod for your profile
items.body: A chat-bubble thumbnail with little floaters, and a sheet with your latest blurbs.

items.title: A rainbow identity
items.body: Blurbs gets its own dark-rainbow look, with a bit of game to it.

items.title: Pet care, partners and a daily check-in
items.body: OO can help with pet care, there's a new bond for partners, and Spine asks how your day went.

items.title: Months open where you stop
items.body: Scroll Spine and the month you settle on opens by itself.

weeks.headline: Build your profile from pods
weeks.dek: Your ID becomes a set of pods you pick and arrange: music, gallery, location, about. And claiming your handle now comes with confetti.

items.title: Profile pods
items.body: Add music, a gallery, where you are, your story, and lay them out the way you like.

items.title: About, expanded
items.body: Tap About to open your whole story, on your own profile and on public ones.

items.title: Claim your @handle, with confetti
items.body: Pick your handle and it bursts. If it's taken, you see who has it.

items.title: A first-blurb reward
items.body: New people get a reward for their first blurb, and topics picked for them from what they like.

items.title: Today, sandwiched
items.body: Past hours sit above the now pill, and what's coming sits below.

weeks.headline: Sealed
weeks.dek: Messages go end-to-end encrypted. DMs, huddles and in-call chat are sealed on every platform, and we can't read them.

items.title: End-to-end encrypted messaging
items.body: DMs, huddles and chat inside calls are sealed on your device before they leave it.

items.title: Translation only with consent
items.body: On sealed calls, live translation only runs when everyone in the call agrees.

items.title: The Arcade gets its own chain
items.body: An Avalanche L1 for the Arcade, the groundwork for what later became Fuel.

items.title: Your living week
items.body: Spine keeps a rolling picture of your week, on every platform.

weeks.headline: Lighter and faster
weeks.dek: A full-stack speed pass: smaller downloads, a quicker database, and live updates instead of constant checking.

items.title: A smaller, faster app
items.body: We cut the app's download size and sped up the database behind it.

items.title: Calls update live
items.body: Pulse uses realtime updates instead of asking the server every few seconds.

items.title: Bubbles opens in a snap
items.body: The Bubbles drawer opens and scrolls faster, even with long histories.

items.title: Delete your account from the app
items.body: One place in Settings, no email required.

weeks.headline: Blocks, widgets and GIFs
weeks.dek: Answers come back as cards, Jokuh lands on your Home Screen, and chats get GIFs and mentions.

items.title: Cortex Blocks
items.body: Answers come back as cards, lists and comparisons you can scan, not walls of text.

items.title: Home Screen widgets
items.body: A set of Jokuh widgets, so the day's brief is one glance away.

items.title: GIFs, mentions and attachments
items.body: A GIF picker, @mentions and richer attachments in every chat.

items.title: Today Brief chips
items.body: Quick chips at the top of Spine for what matters today, with a few new sounds.

items.title: More Arcade
items.body: More games to play inside Jokuh.

weeks.headline: Meet Cortex
weeks.dek: An AI you can chat with that knows your Spine, a look at the sky, and Jokuh in more languages.

items.title: Cortex chat
items.body: Ask anything, and get answers grounded in your own memories.

items.title: Sky lens
items.body: What's happening overhead, right inside your day.

items.title: More languages
items.body: A big translation wave across the app.

items.title: Your devices stay in sync
items.body: Start on your phone, pick it up on your Mac.

weeks.headline: Share anything into Spine
weeks.dek: Send a link, a photo or a note from any app and Jokuh asks where it belongs.

items.title: Share to Spine
items.body: Use the share sheet from any app. Save it to Spine, or turn it into a text or a blurb.

items.title: A daily brief and photo moments
items.body: Open Jokuh to a short brief of your day, with your best photos pulled forward.

items.title: A soundboard
items.body: Drop a sound into the call.

items.title: Dark paper
items.body: Sheets get a dark paper texture, and Nexus learns timers and toasts.
